invoices.sql:
SELECT source_system,currency,canceled,COUNT(*) documents,
COUNT(DISTINCT doc_entry) distinct_documents,
SUM(CAST(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) document_total
FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE doc_date>=? AND doc_date<?
GROUP BY source_system,currency,canceled ORDER BY source_system,currency,canceled
invoices.reference_sql:
SELECT source_system,source_table,doc_entry,currency,canceled,doc_date,doc_total
FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE doc_date>=? AND doc_date<? ORDER BY source_system,doc_entry
invoices.independent_reference: individual document Decimal sums; no SQL aggregate reuse
